svg.title: Two independent sequence interactions: CustomerIntake and ProcessAcceptedIntake

g.text: sd CustomerIntake - Customer Portal Submission & Clarification

This CustomerIntake interaction invokes definition 2 only through the fresh-branch refs.

and scoped upload replay before any new write
JPEG/PNG/PDF <= 10 MiB each; <= 10 references per create/clarification.

Upload replay uses the same receipt/retention rules below.

read authorised current case/history when accessible

case-owned IntakeSession SUBMITTED, intake work and receipt
Show accepted submission; load current progress
Unknown response: recover with the same key and original request.
Replayed receipt is historical, never asserted to be the current view.

append CLARIFICATION statements; advance case/input versions;
invalidate stale derived authority; IntakeSession CLARIFICATION_RECEIVED;
